_note: session_args is passed verbatim to `claude`. Non-empty means the triage agent applies fixes itself; every such run is bracketed by a snapper snapshot and revertible with `undo`, and the report records which files changed. Empty it to go back to diagnose-only.
_note2: triage_rules are journal-notify.sh rule ids. oom/pressure/coredump are intentionally excluded — a Claude session started because RAM ran out competes for the RAM that ran out.

context.hint: osd refuses to propagate this many deletions. Work out WHY the deletions appeared before deciding whether to let them through — a legitimate cleanup and a broken replica look identical from the guard's side. The sync config is ~/.config/osync/osd.toml; the guard is delete_guard.
